notes.title: IZI Mode Update
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce our new update, where you can compete against other players to climb as high as you can on the new leaderboard. From the main menu, you'll be able to access the IZI Mode menu, where you can see your highest score and your ranking on the leaderboard. You'll be able to view both global scores and those of your friends, whom you can also compete with to see who's the best.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177570/e2f8fdf4e7531358d2872ebaca3b8848d7b9957e.png

When you start playing the mode, you'll need to type non-stop—the text is infinite, so don't worry about running out. In this game mode, mistakes won't penalize your time; the most important thing is to keep typing. You'll have a multiplier, which increases as you type faster and maintain a consistent typing rhythm. For every correctly typed character, the multiplier will be added to your score.

Every so often, a power-up will appear in the coffee machine. When you press [Tab], the current text will disappear, and a more challenging one will appear with a time limit to complete it. If you don't finish in time, you'll lose the game. But if you succeed, Oneiro will enjoy a nice cup of coffee, flames will surround him, and the multiplier will double (this lasts for 20 seconds).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177570/8fed1cf2f79812f34425cabed39617cf9f1b2e6e.png

In addition to IZI Mode, all the game's music has been remastered in higher quality. On this note, you can expect more news soon—we're working on making the music available for you to enjoy outside the game!

That's all for this update. You're likely to encounter some bugs in IZI Mode, as this is our first time implementing something like this, and it requires a lot of attention. If you find any errors, you can reach out through the official Oneiro Man Discord to notify us of the issue.

Thank you so much, community—now go play!
